subject.title: fix(secrets): keep unaffected owners live during reload failures

question: Should Gateway reloads retain last-known-good SecretRef values for unchanged non-Gateway owners during retryable resolution outages, while treating changed or uncontracted owners as cold?
rationale: The prior merged foundation explicitly deferred reload isolation, and this PR changes the credential-retention and fail-closed boundary across Gateway, provider-auth, channel, plugin, and web-tool owners.

options.title: Approve bounded reload retention
options.body: Accept the stale-versus-cold policy after reviewing the owner-contract boundary and redacted live Gateway evidence for unchanged, changed, and unrelated owners.

options.title: Keep strict reload semantics
options.body: Retain the current all-or-nothing reload behavior and close or narrow this follow-up rather than introducing last-known-good retention.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded reload retention
recommendation.body: Accept the stale-versus-cold policy after reviewing the owner-contract boundary and redacted live Gateway evidence for unchanged, changed, and unrelated owners.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged feature history and this branch's implementation indicate the strongest context for the intended reload and credential-retention boundary.
